class HelperTransferToken54 {
    public function __destruct() { echo 'TOKEN|'; }
}
function HelperTransferBody54($token) {
    echo 'HELPER|';
    try {
        $received = Fiber::suspend('pause54');
        echo 'HELPER-RESUMED|', (int) ($received === 'resume54'), '|';
        return $received;
    } finally {
        echo 'HELPER-FINALLY|';
    }
}
function HelperTransferHandledGen54($token) {
    global $given;
    echo 'GEN|';
    try {
        $received = HelperTransferBody54($token);
        echo 'GEN-NORMAL|';
    } catch (Exception $caught) {
        echo 'GEN-CAUGHT|', (int) ($caught === $given), '|';
        echo (int) ($caught->getPrevious() === null), '|';
    } finally {
        echo 'GEN-FINALLY|';
    }
    yield 'yield54';
    echo 'GEN-END|';
    return 74;
}
$given = new Exception('supplied54');
$token = new HelperTransferToken54();
$weak = WeakReference::create($token);
$g = HelperTransferHandledGen54($token);
unset($token);
$f = new Fiber(function () {
    global $g;
    echo 'FIBER|';
    $current = $g->current();
    echo 'CURRENT|', (int) ($current === 'yield54'), '|';
    return 'fiber54';
});
echo 'START|', $f->start(), '|';
echo 'PARKED|', (int) $f->isSuspended(), '|', (int) ($weak->get() !== null), '|';
echo 'INJECT|';
$reply = $f->throw($given);
echo 'REPLY|', (int) ($reply === null), '|';
echo 'FIBER-DONE|', (int) $f->isTerminated(), '|', (int) ($f->getReturn() === 'fiber54'), '|';
echo 'LIVE|', (int) ($weak->get() !== null), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'GEN-DONE|', (int) $g->valid(), '|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 74), '|';
echo 'DROPPED|', (int) ($weak->get() === null), '|';
echo 'GIVEN|', (int) ($given->getPrevious() === null), '|';
unset($f, $g, $weak, $given);
